description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three different sentiment analysis tools across two categories of tweets. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis," and displays two groups: "Emoji Tweets" and "Overall Tweet." The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Accuracy," using a linear scale that ranges from 0.0 to 0.8, with major tick marks at regular intervals of 0.2 and minor tick marks every 0.1. The chart features grouped bars, where each group consists of three adjacent bars representing different tools as indicated by the legend located in the bottom right corner. Within each group, the first bar represents "TEXTBLOB" and is colored light grey with a solid black outline; the second bar represents "VADER" and is grey with diagonal black hash lines and a solid black outline; and the third bar represents "ChatGPT" and is a solid dark green color. For the "Emoji Tweets" category, the TEXTBLOB bar is the shortest in the chart at an approximate value of 0.33, followed by VADER at approximately 0.46, and ChatGPT, which is the tallest bar in the chart at approximately 0.67. For the "Overall Tweet" category, TEXTBLOB has an accuracy of approximately 0.40, VADER is at approximately 0.47, and ChatGPT is at approximately 0.66. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted by value, and visually, the TEXTBLOB and VADER bars are distinguished by their black outlines and, in the case of VADER, hatched shading, set against a grey chart background with dashed grid lines.
